body:
Resolve installation and validation limitations:
1. Rename plugin "name" in root plugin.json and .agents/plugins/agb/plugin.json to "antigravity-booster" to fix Jetski installer name validation.
2. Update lib/bootstrap.mjs to support installing both "adlc-antigravity" and the booster plugin itself ("antigravity-booster") during bootstrapping.
3. Support falling back to "jetski plugin install" if "agy" binary is not available but "jetski" is present.
4. Ensure unit tests pass cleanly.
title: feat(bootstrap): rename plugin and automate jetski booster installation during bootstrapping
